INDIA-THAILAND.summary: Indian passport holders can generally enter Thailand visa-free for short tourist stays under current visa-exemption arrangements, though rules have changed periodically.

INDIA-UNITED STATES.summary: Indian passport holders generally need a visa (such as a B1/B2 tourist/business visa) to enter the United States; there is no visa-waiver program for Indian citizens.

UNITED STATES-FRANCE.summary: US passport holders can generally enter France and the wider Schengen Area visa-free for short tourist stays, typically up to 90 days within a 180-day period.
